description: ESPALIER_MAINTENANCE_MODE=1 widening past its documented scope. If `write_guard.main()` short-circuits via the maintenance-mode bypass BEFORE the kill-switch gate and the dangerous-bash/PowerShell pattern checks run, the code contradicts the contract: CLAUDE.md's maintenance-mode table promises the bypass covers only the protected-zone path check, while kill-switch denial and dangerous patterns still fire. Two attack shapes follow: (a) set MAINTENANCE_MODE + run `rm -rf /`, (b) set MAINTENANCE_MODE in a repo with a tampered `.claude/settings.json` carrying `disableAllHooks: true`. The fix re-orders `main()` so kill-switch + dangerous patterns run first, then the bypass applies only to protected-zone path checks.
